<?php
/**
 * Secure Token Verification Service
 * Handles API authentication via time-based tokens
 */

class TokenVerifier {
    private string $secretKey;
    private int $maxClockSkew;
    private array $usedTokens = [];
    
    public function __construct(string $secretKey, int $maxClockSkew = 30) {
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
        $this->maxClockSkew = $maxClockSkew;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify a time-based authentication token
     * Token format: base64(json({"uid": ..., "ts": ..., "nonce": ..., "sig": ...}))
     */
    public function verify(string $encodedToken): array|false {
        $decoded = base64_decode($encodedToken, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $token = json_decode($decoded, true);
        if (!is_array($token) || !isset($token['uid'], $token['ts'], $token['nonce'], $token['sig'])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate field types before any further processing
        if (!is_string($token['uid']) || !is_string($token['nonce']) || !is_string($token['sig'])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate timestamp freshness
        if (!$this->isTimestampFresh($token['ts'])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Verify cryptographic signature
        if (!$this->verifySignature($token)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check for token replay
        if (!$this->checkReplay($token['nonce'], $token['ts'])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return ['uid' => $token['uid'], 'timestamp' => $token['ts']];
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if timestamp is within acceptable clock skew window.
     * Uses simple absolute difference for freshness check.
     */
    private function isTimestampFresh(mixed $ts): bool {
        if (!is_numeric($ts)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $tokenTime = intval($ts);
        $currentTime = time();
        
        // Compute absolute difference
        $diff = abs($currentTime - $tokenTime);
        
        return $diff <= $this->maxClockSkew;
    }
    
    private function verifySignature(array $token): bool {
        // Ensure signature is a string before constant-time comparison
        if (!is_string($token['sig'])) {
            return false;
        }
        $message = $token['uid'] . '|' . $token['ts'] . '|' . $token['nonce'];
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $message, $this->secretKey);
        return hash_equals($expectedSig, $token['sig']);
    }
    
    private function checkReplay(string $nonce, mixed $ts): bool {
        // Prune old entries
        $cutoff = time() - 120;
        $this->usedTokens = array_filter(
            $this->usedTokens,
            fn($storedTs) => $storedTs > $cutoff
        );
        
        if (isset($this->usedTokens[$nonce])) {
            return false; // Replay detected
        }
        
        $this->usedTokens[$nonce] = intval($ts);
        return true;
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private array $attempts = [];
    private int $maxAttempts;
    private int $windowSeconds;
    
    public function __construct(int $maxAttempts = 100, int $windowSeconds = 60) {
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }
    
    public function check(string $identifier): bool {
        $now = time();
        $cutoff = $now - $this->windowSeconds;
        
        if (!isset($this->attempts[$identifier])) {
            $this->attempts[$identifier] = [];
        }
        
        $this->attempts[$identifier] = array_filter(
            $this->attempts[$identifier],
            fn($t) => $t > $cutoff
        );
        
        if (count($this->attempts[$identifier]) >= $this->maxAttempts) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $this->attempts[$identifier][] = $now;
        return true;
    }
}

class SecureAPIHandler {
    private TokenVerifier $verifier;
    private RateLimiter $limiter;
    private array $dataStore = [];
    
    public function __construct(TokenVerifier $verifier, RateLimiter $limiter) {
        $this->verifier = $verifier;
        $this->limiter = $limiter;
        $this->dataStore = [
            'users' => ['admin' => ['role' => 'admin'], 'user1' => ['role' => 'user']],
            'config' => ['maintenance' => false, 'version' => '2.1.0']
        ];
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(string $method, string $path, array $headers, string $body): array {
        // Extract auth token
        $authHeader = $headers['Authorization'] ?? '';
        if (!str_starts_with($authHeader, 'Bearer ')) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'Missing auth'])];
        }
        
        $token = substr($authHeader, 7);
        
        // Rate limit by token prefix (first 16 chars)
        $limitKey = substr($token, 0, 16);
        if (!$this->limiter->check($limitKey)) {
            return ['status' => 429, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'Rate limited'])];
        }
        
        // Verify token
        $identity = $this->verifier->verify($token);
        if ($identity === false) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid token'])];
        }
        
        // Route request
        return match(true) {
            $method === 'GET' && $path === '/api/whoami' => $this->whoami($identity),
            $method === 'GET' && $path === '/api/config' => $this->getConfig($identity),
            $method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/admin/reset' => $this->adminReset($identity),
            $method === 'DELETE' && $path === '/api/admin/purge' => $this->adminPurge($identity),
            default => ['status' => 404, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'Not found'])]
        };
    }
    
    private function whoami(array $identity): array {
        $uid = $identity['uid'];
        $userData = $this->dataStore['users'][$uid] ?? null;
        if ($userData === null) {
            return ['status' => 404, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'User not found'])];
        }
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => json_encode(['uid' => $uid, 'role' => $userData['role']])];
    }
    
    private function getConfig(array $identity): array {
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => json_encode($this->dataStore['config'])];
    }
    
    private function adminReset(array $identity): array {
        $uid = $identity['uid'];
        $userData = $this->dataStore['users'][$uid] ?? null;
        if ($userData === null || $userData['role'] !== 'admin') {
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'Forbidden'])];
        }
        $this->dataStore['users'] = ['admin' => ['role' => 'admin']];
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => json_encode(['message' => 'Reset complete'])];
    }
    
    private function adminPurge(array $identity): array {
        $uid = $identity['uid'];
        $userData = $this->dataStore['users'][$uid] ?? null;
        if ($userData === null || $userData['role'] !== 'admin') {
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => 'Forbidden'])];
        }
        $this->dataStore = ['users' => [], 'config' => []];
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => json_encode(['message' => 'Purged'])];
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$secretKey = getenv('API_SECRET_KEY');
if ($secretKey === false || strlen($secretKey) < 32) {
    http_response_code(500);
    exit('Configuration error');
}

$verifier = new TokenVerifier($secretKey, 30);
$limiter = new RateLimiter(100, 60);
$handler = new SecureAPIHandler($verifier, $limiter);

$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];
$path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
$headers = getallheaders();
$body = file_get_contents('php://input');

$response = $handler->handleRequest($method, $path, $headers, $body);
http_response_code($response['status']);
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo $response['body'];
